title: Integrating Crash Report Mining and LLMs for Bug Localization and Repair: An Industrial Report
abstract: arXiv:2609.04483v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Analyzing crash-report bugs in large-scale industrial software systems requires substantial maintenance effort, particularly in production environments where developers must handle large volumes of crash reports and source code artifacts to localize and fix their root causes. While recent studies have shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) can assist with maintenance tasks, little is known about their effectiveness in supporting developers in analyzing crash-report bugs and repairing bugs associated with groups of crash reports in industrial settings. To address this gap, we investigate whether integrating crash report mining techniques---specifically stack trace clustering and suspicious file and method ranking---with LLMs can support crash localization and repair in production environments. translated_title: 整合崩溃报告挖掘与大语言模型的缺陷定位与修复：一项工业实践报告
translated_abstract: 分析大规模工业软件系统中的崩溃报告缺陷需要大量的维护工作，特别是在生产环境中，开发人员必须处理海量的崩溃报告和源代码工件，以定位并修复缺陷的根本原因。尽管近期研究表明大语言模型（LLM）可以协助维护任务，但人们对其在工业环境中支持开发人员分析崩溃报告缺陷、以及修复与崩溃报告组相关缺陷的有效性知之甚少。为了填补这一空白，我们研究了将崩溃报告挖掘技术——特别是堆栈跟踪聚类以及可疑文件与方法排序——与大语言模型相结合，能否在生产环境中支持崩溃定位与修复。我们在四种提示配置下对五个大语言模型进行了回顾性评估，随后选出最佳模型在38个崩溃缺陷上运行……
tldr: 该工业研究将崩溃报告挖掘技术（堆栈跟踪聚类与可疑文件/方法排序）与大语言模型相结合，评估了多种LLM在生产环境中定位和修复崩溃缺陷的有效性。
en_tdlr: This industrial study integrates crash report mining techniques (stack trace clustering and suspicious file/method ranking) with LLMs, evaluating multiple models' effectiveness in localizing and repairing crash bugs in production environments.
